from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyObservation(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a report."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month the data corresponds to, in YYYY-MM format")
    permits_saar: float = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total building permits")
    starts_saar: float = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total housing starts")
    report_month: str = Field(description="The primary month of the report providing this data (YYYY-MM), used for precedence resolution (later reports override earlier ones)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    observations: list[MonthlyObservation]
